_comment: Larkspan's CRM (apps/crm), imported by hack/demo/seed.sh through POST /api/apps/crm/import. Fictional companies and people; domains under .example, phone numbers in the 555-01xx fictional range. Times are relative ({daysAgo, at}, {minutesAgo}, {inDays}) and resolved when the data is imported.

activity.text: Sent the revised order form: 60 vans from {{longdate:+66}}, three-year term, $70 per van held.
Check-in with Keisha: route recalculation back under 2 s since Tuesday's fix. She still wants the SLA in writing before renewal.
Security review with Simone Clarke: SSO and audit-log questions answered. Questionnaire due {{date:+4}}.
Pilot week 2: 11% fewer miles on the Grand Rapids yard routes than their manual plans, zero missed crane windows.
Moved "Expansion: +60 vans for the Dayton DC" to Negotiation.
Henrik confirmed budget for Green Bay and Eau Claire; wants the depot hand-off rules demoed before signing.
QBR with Dana and Marcus: on-time rate 96.4% (91% at go-live), 7% fewer miles. Dayton DC wants the driver app next.
Two tickets this week: driver app logs out on Android 15. Fix is in 4.12, shipping Monday.
Intro with Sam Whitaker (new VP Ops). Walked through August's API latency incident, the fix and the status page.
Inbound from the website: 31 vans, routes in spreadsheets, dispatch by phone. Discovery call booked.
Sent the proposal with the reefer temperature integration and a 2-depot rollout plan.
Discovery with Nate: 120 vans, same-day parts to ~900 garages; mid-day re-planning is the must-have.
Holiday peak add-on is live. Lucy wants Valentine's Day capacity planned by January 15.
Olivia used the route-savings calculator (est. 14% fewer miles). Intro call next week.
Closed lost: stayed with their telematics vendor's bundled routing.
Shared the multi-depot playbook and two reference customers.
Aaron wants order-created webhooks into their ERP; scoped a two-week integration.
